headline: A year of daily learning adds up to remarkable transformation
universal_truth: Consistent small steps create extraordinary journeys
fun_facts: If you improve just 1% each day, you'll be 37 times better after one year
The compound effect applies to learning: each day's lesson builds on previous ones, creating exponential growth
Research shows that daily learning habits activate neuroplasticity more effectively than intensive but sporadic study
discussion_questions: How are you different today than 365 days ago?
What lesson from this year made the biggest impact?
What would you like next year's learning journey to focus on?

hook.title: Welcome
hook.script: Here we are—Day 365. You've shown up, day after day, to learn something new. That might seem simple, but it's not. Consistency is rare. Today we celebrate what you've done and what it means.

options.text: I want to learn something new
options.response: Perfect. Curiosity is the first step to understanding. Let's explore this together.
That curiosity is exactly what we need. Let's dive in and discover something amazing.

cliff.title: The Question
cliff.script: 365 lessons. 365 opportunities to grow. But here's the question: where does all that learning go? Does it just stack up, or does something bigger happen?

options.response: Yes. Not dramatically different—but profoundly different. Small changes accumulate into new capabilities, perspectives, and possibilities.
That's true, but facts are just the surface. The deeper change is in how you think, connect ideas, and see the world.

q1.title: The Compound Effect
q1.script: Improving 1% per day means being 37 times better after a year. That's not motivation hype—it's mathematics. Daily learning isn't about any single lesson. It's about the cumulative effect of showing up, again and again.
q1.prompt: What's your first impression of "The Compound Effect"?

options.text: This confirms what I already knew
options.response: Great foundation! Now let's build on that knowledge with something you might not expect...
Perfect starting point! This insight will connect to even more surprising facts ahead.

q2.title: Neuroplasticity in Action
q2.script: Your brain physically changes when you learn consistently. New neural pathways form and strengthen. The person listening to this today has a different brain than the one who started 365 days ago. Learning literally reshapes you.
q2.prompt: How does this connect to what you already know?

options.response: Exactly. These connections are how knowledge becomes understanding.

options.text: I need to think about this more
options.response: That's a good instinct. Deep understanding takes time. The next fact will help clarify.

q3.title: The Identity Shift
q3.script: The biggest change might be in how you see yourself. You're someone who learns every day. That's not just a habit—it's an identity. And identity shapes everything else: choices, focus, and what you believe is possible.
q3.prompt: What surprises you most about this?

options.text: I never thought about it this way
options.response: That shift in perspective is exactly the point. New angles reveal new truths.
That's learning in action. When understanding shifts, you're really getting it.

wisdom.title: Today's Wisdom
wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: What you did this year wasn't just consume information. You built something—a practice, a habit, a way of being. Carry that into the next year and the year after. The journey continues.
wisdom.prompt: What resonates most with you today?

options.response: That central truth will stay with you. Let it guide your thinking.
Application is where knowledge becomes wisdom. That's the real learning.

outro.title: See You Tomorrow
outro.script: That's 365 lessons. A full year of growing together. I'm proud of you for showing up. Whatever comes next, you've proven you can learn, adapt, and grow—one day at a time. See you on the other side.
outro.prompt: Before you go—what will you take from today?

options.response: Reflection deepens learning. Let these ideas simmer in your mind.
Teaching others is the best way to learn. You've already begun the ripple.

growTrack.title: Year Complete - The Growth Inventory
growTrack.learning_objective: Acknowledge and celebrate a full year of consistent learning
growTrack.activity: Write a letter to yourself from one year ago. Tell past-you what you've learned, how you've grown, and what you're grateful for from this year of daily lessons. Keep it somewhere you'll find it next year.
